uutiset.t: Anthropic Rebounds From 10% Drop as Markets Stage Dramatic Recovery | Closing Bell
uutiset.s: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Carol Massar and Lisa Mateo. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Market Volatility Highly Unlikely To Continue: Kindler
uutiset.s: Robert Kindler, global chair of the M&A group at Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison, joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." They discussed the record pace for M&A. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: US Tariff Proposal Raises Stakes for India to Clinch Trade Deal
uutiset.s: US tariff rates announced Wednesday put pressure on India to agree to a trade deal or face a higher levy, leaving exporters and investors with little clarity on the trade outlook.

uutiset.t: The Debate Over Where Anthropic’s New Millionaires Should Donate Their Money
uutiset.s: Sarah Holder sits down with GiveDirectly CEO Nick Allardice and Center for Effective Philanthropy President Phil Buchanan, who debate how to turn pledges into action and who should decide how money gets spent. Listen to the Big Take wherever you get your podcasts. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Targa Is Said in Talks to Buy Kinetik in Major Pipeline Tie-Up
uutiset.s: Targa Resources Corp. is in talks to acquire Kinetik Holdings Inc., a publicly-listed pipeline company partly owned by Blackstone Inc., according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Mega Rail Deal Gets Unusual WH Meeting
uutiset.s: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter. uutiset.t: Netflix Buys Seinfeld Studio Lot After Goldman Forecloses
uutiset.s: Bloomberg's John Gittelsohn joins Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg Deals." Netflix announced it’s buying Radford Studio Center, the historic Los Angeles lot where Seinfeld was filmed, for $380 million after Goldman Sachs Group took control of the property. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Blue Owl, Blackstone Make Rare Pension Deal
uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Layan Odeh joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." A top US pension is considering raising roughly $4 billion in a complex financing bundling stakes in private credit funds managed by Blackstone, Blue Owl Capital and others, according to people familiar with the matter. uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Naomi Kresge joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Sanofi shares climbed on Wednesday to the highest since May 2025, adding to yesterday’s strong gains following the announcement of its planned acquisition of US drugmaker Insmed. uutiset.t: Egypt Road Accident Kills at Least 30 in Greater Cairo
uutiset.s: At least 30 people were killed in Greater Cairo after a truck carrying petroleum products caught fire in one Egypt’s deadliest road accidents in years.

uutiset.t: GTCR Is Said to Weigh $50B Global Payments Buyout
uutiset.s: Bloomberg's Mengqi Sun joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." GTCR confirmed in a filing that it’s exploring a takeover of Global Payments in what would be one of the biggest-ever leveraged buyouts. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: BNP Paribas Hit by Higher Capital Surcharge Under New GSIB List
uutiset.s: BNP Paribas SA was hit with an extra 50 basis points capital requirement by the Financial Stability Board after the French bank moved into a different tier for the world’s most systemically important banks.

uutiset.t: Australia’s Beaten-Down Small Caps Look Primed for 2027 Comeback
uutiset.s: Australia’s small-cap stocks may offer a buying opportunity in the year ahead as relatively attractive valuations and potential interest-rate cuts brighten their earnings outlook, providing an alternative to a broader market struggling for growth.

uutiset.t: Anthropic’s Post-IPO Woes Contrast With SpaceX’s Start
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC is experiencing a rougher initiation to public markets than SpaceX, and a host of market and technical factors threaten to weigh down its stock performance before the Claude developer reports for the first time as a public company early next year.
